# Merge yearly data

This script merges the yearly data.

## Data

**Input**
  - DemographyGunOwners/data/raw/gunsurvey/

**Output**
  - - DemographyGunOwners/data/constructed/

**Last ran**
  - 12/12/2O25

```{r,  message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

packages <-
  c(
    "tidyverse",
    "purrr",
    "haven",
    "tidyr",
    "janitor",
    "skimr",
    "psych",
    "dplyr",
    "here"
  )

pacman::p_load(
  packages,
  character.only = TRUE
)
```

## Import and bind

```{r}
for (i in c(2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023)){
  
  assign(
    paste0("data_", i),
    read_rds(
     here(
      path_od, 
      "data",
      "raw",
      "gunsurvey",
      paste0(i, ".rds")
      )
    )
  )
} 
```
